publish_edits_note: The order for #886. First, after Kris approves the final copy for publication: record publish_approval, set status_target to publish and apply these edits to the payload, with {publish_date} set to publish_approval.date. The tests then check the final body. Second, stage that final body in draft wordpress_id while it is still a draft, so the preview Kris checks is exactly what will go public. Third, after his yes on that preview, publishing is a status-only flip of that ID, with no slug, title or body change (#886 step 9). Every replace is non-empty so the tests can rebuild the pending page from the final one.
